system.description: You taste the air and feel its pressure on your skin.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the Boon lasts for the whole day's travel.
outcomes.success: The next time you roll on the Weather table, roll twice and choose. Until then, you have Boon on navigation tests.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the air tells you nothing.
outcomes.ruin: You read the sky wrong: the next time you roll on the Weather table, roll twice and the Dark Master chooses. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
